paraphrase: Therefore the beginner's practice (ādikarma) — generosity to the point of the body, discipline, patience, effort, meditation and wisdom — goes on even for those established in the mad observance.

original.text: tatra hetvavasthāsthitena sarvamādikarma kartavyam | phalāvasthāsatvārthakriyāvasthāsthitasya ca śākyamuneriva anābhogena ādikarma pravartata eva iti |

paraphrase: Of the three states — cause (from bodhicitta to the seat of awakening), fruit and activity for beings — the one in the causal state must perform all the beginner's practices; for one in the states of fruit and activity, like Śākyamuni, the beginner's practice proceeds without effort.
notes: From the Kudṛṣṭinirghātana's gloss (ṭippaṇī) printed after the root-downfall section.
